def test_model_loss():
        """Checks to see if the loss of the recovered model is lower than
        the original model"""
        true_model = RecoveredModel(
            input_dim=64,
            d_model=128,
            nhead=4,
            num_encoder_layers=3,
            num_decoder_layers=1,
            dim_feedforward=256,
            dropout=0.0,

        true_model.eval()
